definitions.short: Kerioth , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H7152. Qeriyyoth קרִיּוֺת proper name, of a location (formed as plural intensive from קִרְיָה ?); — 1 in Judah Josh 15:25 ( αἱ πόλεις ; whence, as supposed, Judas קְרִיּוֺת אִישׁ ), perhaps †aryatên , approximately 12 miles south of Hebron, Buhl Geogr. 182. 2 in Moab , Καριωθ , αἱ πόλεις ; MI 13 קרית : Jer 48:24 , ׳הַקּ 48:41 ; Amos 2:2 ; perhaps = Ραββαθ Μωαβ = Μοαβ = Αρεοπολις (Euseb., see Lag Onom. 277, 60 and others), modern Rabba , approximately 11 miles south of Arnon, compare Buhl Geogr. 270 .
